facts.claim: Four nonprofits are plaintiffs: Irreplaceable Education Fund, Public Citizen, Heat Initiative, Alliance for Secure AI.
facts.verbatim_support: Plaintiffs (4 nonprofits): Irreplaceable Education Fund, Public Citizen, Heat Initiative, Alliance for Secure AI

facts.claim: Defendants are Anthropic, Google, Meta, OpenAI and SpaceX.
facts.verbatim_support: Anthropic, Google, Meta, OpenAI, and SpaceX

facts.claim: Case is in San Francisco Superior Court.
The nonprofits seek an immediate emergency injunction on next-generation models from major tech firms.
facts.verbatim_support: an immediate emergency injunction on next-generation models from major tech firms

facts.claim: Companies must prove the technology is under human control (before resuming).
facts.verbatim_support: prove the technology is under human control

facts.claim: The complaint cites AI-driven cyberattacks and the companies' own admissions that unregulated technologies could go rogue, plus catastrophic harm.
facts.verbatim_support: AI-driven cyberattacks; could go rogue; catastrophic harm

facts.claim: Complaint quote: "No other industry is allowed to treat its own development of unsafe products—much less ones that could kill us all—as inevitable."
facts.verbatim_support: No other industry is allowed to treat its own development of unsafe products—much less ones that could kill us all—as inevitable.

facts.claim: Congress has yet to pass legislation governing AI.
facts.verbatim_support: Despite years of warnings, Congress has yet to pass legislation governing AI.

timeline.event: Lawsuit reported (Al Jazeera article date); filed 'Thursday'.

unsupported: 'Catastrophic risk admissions' as a phrase: source says admissions that tech 'could go rogue' and complaint cites 'catastrophic harm'; not a verbatim 'catastrophic risk admission'.
'Some warnings came from the builders themselves': supported only as 'companies' own admissions'; no named builder warning was extracted.
'Rogue warnings' is loose; the source says admissions that technologies 'could go rogue'.

wording_fixes.script_phrase: The complaint cites cyberattacks, rogue warnings, and catastrophic risk admissions.
wording_fixes.safer_phrase: The complaint cites AI-driven cyberattacks and the companies' own admissions that AI could go rogue.

wording_fixes.script_phrase: Some warnings came from the builders themselves.
wording_fixes.problem: No specific builder named in source.
wording_fixes.safer_phrase: The complaint leans on the companies' own admissions.

wording_fixes.script_phrase: A court is being asked to hit pause on frontier AI.
wording_fixes.problem: Fine; court is San Francisco Superior Court, injunction is on next-generation models.
wording_fixes.safer_phrase: A San Francisco court is being asked to stop next-generation AI models.
